text:
mika: Hi team  I got married yesterday! How do I add my spouse and my new stepson to benefits? Also planning a legal name change  is that handled together?

 tara - People Ops: Congrats Mika!! :tada: Marriage is a Qualifying Life Event. You have 30 days from the wedding date to enroll your spouse and dependents. For the name change, you can update your personal info separately but we can coordinate so benefits and payroll reflect the new name together.

 mika: Great. What docs do you need and where do I upload them?

 tara - People Ops: For spouse: marriage certificate (certified copy) and spouse DOB/SSN (or last 4). For stepson: birth certificate and proof of relationship (if not on marriage cert, a court or agency placement letter). If youve already started the legal name change but no SSN update yet, you can enroll and mark SSN pending; provide SSN/update within 60 days to avoid claim delays. Upload everything to the Life Event form on the benefits portal (open_enroll.redwood.com/qle) or email benefits@redwood.com with subject "QLE - marriage - [Mika Lastname]".

 mika: If I change my legal name, will payroll need additional forms?

 dylan - Payroll: Yes, for payroll we need the legal name change document (marriage cert or court order) plus an updated W-4 if your filing status or withholding preferences change. Also bring ID changes for bank or direct deposit updates if needed. We can sync benefits effective date and payroll name change to the same pay cycle if docs arrive before the payroll cutoff.

 mika: Can we make coverage effective on the wedding date?

 tara - People Ops: We can set the benefits effective date as the wedding date if you enroll within 30 days and provide the certificate. If you miss 30 days the next available option is Open Enrollment unless you have another QLE.

 hr-bot: Submission received. Case ID: QLE-20260808-224. A People Ops rep will review within 2 business days.

 mika: Uploaded marriage cert and stepson birth cert, marked spouse SSN pending (spouse will apply for SSN next week).

 tara - People Ops: I see the case. Please add stepson's full name and DOB in the secure portal note (do not post SSNs here). I'll mark effective date as 2026-08-07 (wedding date) and start enrollments. Dylan  I flagged payroll for name change sync.

 dylan - Payroll: Got the flag. I'll wait for confirmation of the effective date and then run the name change payroll steps. If any retro premiums are needed we'll reconcile next payroll.

 mika: Thanks all! Appreciate the help :heart:
